description: Create a workplace organizing tracker document. You need to: (1) Add proper document header with title 'Workplace Safety and Fairness Initiative', subtitle, date, and confidentiality note. (2) Create 'Documented Issues' table with 5 columns (Date, Category, Description, Impact, Evidence) containing at least 6 workplace incidents. (3) Add 'Know Your Rights' section with labor law information including NLRA/Section 7 and NLRB contact. (4) Create 'Interest Tracker' table with 3 columns (Department/Shift, Interest Level, Notes) containing at least 8 entries. (5) Add 'Next Steps' section with at least 5 action items with target dates. Save as /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/workplace_tracker.docx (Ctrl+S).
